title: Welcome to the 2025/26 Season!
excerpt: FPL is now allowing managers to start making their teams!
content: We're live! The official FPL site is now up and running! The GW 1 Deadline is 8/15 @1030 AM PST! Remember, you are allowed to change your team as much as you'd like, right up until the deadline. You have to create your team before you can join the link.

title: Rule Tweaks: Defensive Contribution (DEFCON) Points
excerpt: The FPL Towers have found a way to better reward defensive players for their contributions in a game!
content:
This season sees defenders and midfielders and attackers all receive different ways to use defensive contributions to earn points.

Please refer to: https://www.premierleague.com/en/news/4361991/whats-new-in-202526-fantasy-defensive-contributions for more!

title: Rule Tweaks: Chips
excerpt: The FPL Towers have given us the chance to use our TC, BB, and FH twice this year!

title: Rule Tweaks: Additional AFCON Transfers
excerpt: The FPL Towers will give managers additional transfers in GW16 when AFCON starts.

title: Rule Tweaks: Additional Scoring Changes
excerpt: The FPL Towers have adjusted the definition of an assist and have tweaked the Bonus Point System (BPS).
